title: Mover Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for moving services — loading, transport, unloading, packing and boxes. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. All items handled with care; valuation coverage noted on the invoice.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled moving line items: loading, transport, unloading, packing, boxes
EIN / Tax ID and business fields for clean client-facing invoices
Loading and unloading priced per hour with transport as a flat line

faqs.q: What should I include on a mover invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and DOT/MC number (for interstate moves), the client and origin/destination addresses, a dated line-item list (loading, transport, unloading, packing, boxes), tax, and total due. Note valuation coverage level.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
